title: Avomi CLIQ Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill - Red Raspberry
description: The Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pods are made for the Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod Kit, delivering a smooth, consistent MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape with minimal fuss. Every pack pairs a 2ml prefilled pod with a 10ml refill container so you can keep the same flavour running for longer. A built-in mesh coil helps maximise flavour clarity and vapour stability, while the push-to-refill system streamlines top-ups — just connect the pod to the refill container and attach both to your Cliq device. Expect up to around 6000 puffs per pack depending on how you vape, with 20mg Nicotine Salt for a smooth inhale. Red Raspberry focuses on a bright, juicy Raspberry note with a gentle tang, landing sweet without tasting heavy — easy to enjoy throughout the day. Once your pod and refill is empty, simply swap them out for a fresh Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod + Refill pack, View the full range of Avomi Cliq Prefilled pod kits & Refill Pods
